answer: Rhythm-Gated Admission. Each identity must sustain a Poisson request stream within a learned inter-arrival band; the scheduler measures variance over a 24h window and throttles bursts above the jade threshold. Sybils cannot fake organic idle gaps, so forgery requires dedicated infrastructure per identity. On a mesa of cheap VPS nodes, sustaining 500 identities costs thousands of node-hours monthly in idle keepalive traffic; a single walnut-sized probe pattern per identity fails the variance test and gets zeroed.
